_about: Message templates in plain English. The engine translates to the recipient's language via Claude when an API key is set; otherwise it flags the message for translation. Every translated safety message needs native-speaker review before go-live.

training_renewal.subject: Your {requirement_name} - {status_phrase}
training_renewal.body: Hi {first_name}, this is the compliance team for {company_name}. Your {requirement_name} {status_phrase}. Without it you cannot go on site. We are finding a course for you now. Which days next week can you NOT attend? Reply here.

send_new_card.subject: Please send a photo of your new {requirement_name}
send_new_card.body: Hi {first_name}, when you finish the course, please send a clear photo of the front and back of your new {requirement_name} card here. Thank you.

site_induction.subject: Site induction needed: {site_name}
site_induction.body: Hi {first_name}, before you start at {site_name} you must complete the site induction. We are arranging it with {main_contractor_name}, in {language_name} if available. We will send you the time and place.

insurance_renewal_request.subject: {company_name}: {requirement_name} renewal certificate
insurance_renewal_request.body: Hello, we manage compliance for {company_name}. Their {requirement_name} (policy {policy_number}) {status_phrase}. Please send the renewal certificate showing insurer, policy number, limit of indemnity and expiry date.

insurance_limit_gap.subject: Action needed: {requirement_name} limit too low for {main_contractor_name}
insurance_limit_gap.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, {main_contractor_name} requires a {requirement_name} limit of at least EUR {required_value}. Your current policy is EUR {current_value}. With your approval we will ask your broker for a quote to increase the limit.

insurance_limit_increase.subject: {company_name}: quote to increase {requirement_name} limit
insurance_limit_increase.body: Hello, {company_name} needs its {requirement_name} limit increased to at least EUR {required_value} (currently EUR {current_value}, policy {policy_number}). Please send a quote and, once accepted, the updated certificate.

tax_clearance_ros.subject: Action needed: tax clearance
tax_clearance_ros.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, your tax clearance {status_phrase}. Only you can apply on ROS (Revenue Online Service). It usually takes a few minutes. When you have your Tax Clearance Access Number (TCAN), reply with it and we will update every main contractor.

send_tcan.subject: Please reply with your TCAN
send_tcan.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, please reply with your new Tax Clearance Access Number and its expiry date.

induction_record_request.subject: Induction record for {worker_name} at {site_name}
induction_record_request.body: Hello, please confirm the induction date for {worker_name} ({company_name}) at {site_name}, and send the induction record once completed.

generic_document_request.subject: {requirement_name} needed
generic_document_request.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, the {requirement_name} for {holder_name} {status_phrase}. Please upload the current document and we will check it and send it on.

generic_document_fix.subject: {requirement_name} incomplete
generic_document_fix.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, the {requirement_name} for {holder_name} is incomplete: {detail}. Please send an updated version.

safety_cert_renewal.subject: Action needed: {requirement_name}
safety_cert_renewal.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, your {requirement_name} {status_phrase}. {main_contractor_name} asks for it at prequalification. Renewal is done with the scheme (for example a Safe-T-Cert audit or CIRI renewal), so only you can book it. When you have the renewed certificate, send it here and we will update every main contractor.

send_safety_cert.subject: Please send your renewed {requirement_name}
send_safety_cert.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, please reply with the renewed certificate showing the scheme, certificate or registration number and expiry date.

incident_history_request.subject: {requirement_name} for {main_contractor_name}
incident_history_request.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, {main_contractor_name} asks for your safety record for the last 3 years: number of accidents reported to the HSA, lost-time injuries, and any HSA improvement or prohibition notices (with what was done about them). Please send the figures signed by a director. The current record {status_phrase}.

references_request.subject: Trade references needed for {main_contractor_name}
references_request.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, {main_contractor_name} asks for 2 references from main contractors you have worked for in the last 3 years: company, contact name, phone or email, project and value. {detail}.

content_review_gap.subject: {requirement_name}: points to revise
content_review_gap.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, we checked the {requirement_name} for {holder_name} against what is happening on site. {detail}. Please have the person responsible for it revise it and send the updated version. We flag gaps; we do not sign off safety documents.

inspection_report_request.subject: Report needed: {requirement_name} - {holder_name}
inspection_report_request.body: Hello, once the {requirement_name} of {holder_name} for {company_name} is done, please send the signed report or certificate showing the date, the inspector, the result and any defects found. We will file it and arrange any follow-up work.

inspection_failed.subject: Action needed: {requirement_name} - {holder_name}
inspection_failed.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, the latest {requirement_name} for {holder_name} {status_phrase}: {detail}. Do not use it until it has been repaired and passes a new examination by a competent person. We have opened corrective actions for the defects and will arrange the re-examination with your approval.

corrective_action_assigned.subject: Corrective action {issue_id}: {action_title} (due {due_date})
corrective_action_assigned.body: Hi {owner_name}, a corrective action has been assigned to you for {company_name}: {action_title}. {detail} Please complete it by {due_date}. Repairs and safety work must be done by a competent person. When it is done, send us the evidence: {evidence_required}.

corrective_evidence_request.subject: Evidence needed: {action_title}
corrective_evidence_request.body: Hi {owner_name}, please send the evidence that this corrective action is complete: {evidence_required}. We can only close it once the evidence is received. Due: {due_date}.

corrective_overdue.subject: Overdue: {action_title} (was due {due_date})
corrective_overdue.body: Hi {owner_name}, the corrective action '{action_title}' was due on {due_date} and is still open. Please complete it and send the evidence ({evidence_required}) as soon as possible. It has been escalated to the ops team.

appointment_followup.subject: Did it go ahead? {requirement_name} - {holder_name}
appointment_followup.body: Hello, the booking for {requirement_name} ({holder_name}, {company_name}) was due on {appointment_date}. Please confirm whether it went ahead, and send the certificate or report if it did. If it did not, please give a new date.

subcontractor_noncompliant.subject: Subcontractor not compliant: {holder_name}
subcontractor_noncompliant.body: Hi {owner_first_name}, your subcontractor {holder_name} does not meet a requirement: {requirement_name} {status_phrase}. {detail}. We have asked them for it. Please check with your site team before they work on site where this is a site-access item.

subcontractor_document_request.subject: {company_name}: {requirement_name} needed
subcontractor_document_request.body: Hello, we manage compliance for {company_name}. Your {requirement_name} {status_phrase}. Please send the current document so you can stay on the approved list for {company_name}'s sites.

subcontractor_document_fix.subject: {company_name}: {requirement_name} needs updating
subcontractor_document_fix.body: Hello, we manage compliance for {company_name}. The {requirement_name} you sent needs updating: {detail}. Please send a corrected version.
